lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible. Centroids are arranged in a semi-regular 2D grid, with the highest-intensity clusters located in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical high-luminance bands intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, particularly in the central-posterior region of the visible flank, forming distinct grid-like anchor points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with specular highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Three prominent, roughly parallel diagonal white linear abrasions/scars are visible on the upper-mid flank. A single dark circular lesion or mark is present on the far posterior-right area of the flank.
other_distinctive_markers: A region of high-luminance serpentine or vermiculated markings is present immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, which transitions into discrete circular spots further back along the flank.
